juṇhā:
Juṇhā (f.) [Sk. jyotsnā, see also P. dosinā) 달빛, 달빛 있는 밤, 한 달의 상현 (opp. kālapakkha)
Vin I.138, 176; J I.165; IV.498 (°pakkha).
juti: Juti (f.) [Sk. jyuti & dyuti, to dyotate, see jotati] 광채, 밝음, 광휘, 빛 J II.353; PvA 122, 137, 198. M I.328 (gati+juti 합성) 에서 juti 로 표기한 것은 cuti 에 대한 실수인 듯하다(so as v. l. given on p. 557). --dhara (jutin°) 불빛을 나르는, 빛을 비추는, 빛남, 광휘, 광채 S I.121; J II.353; DhA I.432.
jutika: Jutika (adj.) (--°) 빛이 있는, in mahā° 대단한 광채 D II.272; A I.206; IV.248.
jutimatā: Jutimatā (f.) [fr. jutimant] 광채, 밝음, 빼어남 J 14; V.405
jutimant: Jutimant (adj.) [fr. juti] 빛나는, 밝은; 보통 비유적으로, 빼어난 지혜: "밝은" 뚜렷한, 위대한 빛(in this sense often as v. l. to jātimant) D II.256 (ī); S V.24; Dh 89 (=DhA II.163 nāṇajutiyā jotetvā); Sn 508; Pv IV.135 (=PvA 230 nāṇajutiyā jutimā).
juhati: Juhati [Sk. juhoti, *gheu(d); cp. Gr. xe/w, xQtra, xu_los; Lat. fundo; Goth. giutan, Ohg. giozan] (불에)붓다, 희생제를 치르다, 바치다; 제공하다, 헌신하다A II.207 (aggiṁ); Sn 1046 (=Nd2 263 deti cīvaraṁ, etc.); 428 (aggihuttaṁ jūhato), p. 79 (aggiṁ); Pug 56; fut. juhissati S I.166 (aggiṁ); caus. hāpeti2 pp. huta; see also hava, havi, homa.
juhana: Juhana (nt.) [fr. juhati] offering, sacrifice D I.12, J II.43.
